Results.ReviewText: I have owned a Weber 22" grille for over 11 years and enjoyed using it to cook and smoke on a regular basis.  The old grille finally rusted out so after 11 years it was time for a new Weber.  I purchased a new 22 " grille almost identical to the original.  The assembly out of the box was easy following the instructions provided.  The installation of the ash catcher was another story.  It was VERY difficult install during assembly.  The only way to get it installed was to use a pair of plyers to squeeze the handle together to get it into position on the rack that is designed to hold it in place.  The removal of the ash catcher for the first time was again VERY difficult even with the use of plyers to squeeze the handles together.  I now have a pot holding the ash catcher in place in order to use the ash catcher.  The handle was deformed getting it removed from the support rack.  The grille is fine but some thought is needed to get removal simpler.  Could not recommend this grille to anyone

Results.ReviewText:
I have had my eye on the Weber kettle as long as I can remember but the cost always left me apprehensive. I was recently surprised when I found a previous year model on clearance and the offer was too good to pass up. I owned the smaller version for years and while I have zero complaints overall it's not something you can cook for a crowd on. The 22" Original Kettle Premium has enough elbow room (more specifically wings, legs and thighs) to cook for family and friends.

The biggest surprise out of the box was the heft and build quality of the components. I expected lightweight materials and flimsy legs, handles, etc.. What I got was a heavy duty, ruggedly built grill that will last a lifetime. There is a reason that Weber has the reputation it does. It's quality.  

The 22" size is perfect for offset cooking so cuts that require low and slow can get the perfect cook you are looking for. Toss in a chunk of wood every now and then and you essentially have a smoker. While my electric smoker has the ease of 'set it and forget it' it doesn't hold a candle to the authentic smoked character that the Weber provides. Charcoal adds flavor that you just don't get in other cooking methods. 

If you have been on the fence with a Weber Kettle of any size or model I would enthusiastically encourage you to do so. I never thought a simple charcoal grill would have so much impact on my day to day grilling and help me to become a better pit master in such a short time. Try it! You'll love it too!
Results.Title: A simple charcoal grill...but so much more.

Results.ReviewText:
My dad always had a Weber kettle grill. He and I would grill all year, in the winter we’d wear our winter gear and cook.
As a wedding gift my parents got me a Weber kettle grill, green. 
25 years later that grill is in need of being replaced. The wooden handles rotted off years ago. The cleaning system and ash catch pan fell off. I melted the wheels while burning sticks and pine cones in the grill. 
My grill sits outside year round. Covered in ice and snow. It’s been blown over by straight line winds. Ridden hundreds of miles in the utility trailer on vacation. 
These are expensive for a charcoal grill. I have no idea how much mine cost when new. But I am buying another and I will keep my current one for backyard fires. 
I have cooked everything on my grill, pizza, using my cast iron skillet I’ve made breakfast. I’ve used it as a smoker...
The nice thing about charcoal grills is you know exactly how much charcoal you have left. There is no running out of propane half way through your meal. You have your bag of Kingsford and you can see how much you have left. 
Buy one. It is the best there is. It will last forever and you will not be sorry you did.

Results.ReviewText:
We bought this Weber to replace our previous one that had weathered the Florida weather outdoors for 13 years.  We upgraded to the model that was a little bit fancier--thermometer on the lid, ash catcher at the bottom--and have been MORE than pleased with the results.  Both of these additions are welcome.  I know my fire is at the right temperature AND the ashes go right into a little bowl.  MUCH easier to clean up!

I'm using this grill two or three times a week, and have NOT YET screwed up a dinner or lunch!  I am no cook, believe me, but the Weber makes grilling dinner very easy. The only difficult part (for me) was making certain the coals were ready for the food. Using lighter fluid, at least for me, is a guessing game.  How much is too much, and if you use too little, the coals won't properly ignite.

I wised up a few weeks after getting the grill and ponied up $15 for the Weber Rapidfire Chimney starter.  Quit wasting $$ on lighter fluid; this contraption gets the coals going in about 20 minutes.  And you can pour them out on the charcoal grate as you please!

One particular triumph I'd like to add: barbecuing CHICKEN was something I had avoided until getting this new grill.  You don't want to UNDERCOOK chicken, and that was my fear.  Fortunately, Weber's manual gives you all sorts of guidelines about how to cook meat.  And when I followed their instructions, the chicken has turned out delicious!  Now my family looks forward to me grilling chicken for an evening dinner!  

Bottom line?  This grill is well worth the money!  I look forward to grilling on this Weber for another 13 years!
Results.Title: How much do I love this grill? C'mon, it's a WEBER

I had a minor issue with the lid on the kettle when i got it but I contacted Weber and within 5 minutes the support staff resolved my issue well beyond my expectations. 14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs.
